source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: At Declare Battle Formations, optionally assign the Shadow Weaver Platform to a Guardian Defenders unit on your roster. A recipient may take only one of this type of weapons model. Add the platform to the unit’s Starting Strength and keep it in that unit through battle end. Embarking in a TRANSPORT is prohibited for the platform and the rest of its unit.

attachment.addOwnerModelTo: one Guardian Defenders unit in own army
